cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Count What I Did
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your fence has passed my inspection. You may now thank me for the Saturday it took.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I just say thanks? It was three panels.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three panels, eighteen screws, two shops and a blister. I approve a thank-you of corresponding length.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll recommend you to next door. They've got six panels.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Recommendation approved only if you tell them what three cost me. You may praise my Saturday without volunteering my Sunday.
